# SAVE_SKILL repo_copy
import os
import requests
import base64

# GitHub API configuration
TOKEN = os.environ.get("GITHUB_TOKEN") or os.environ.get("GH_TOKEN")
HEADERS = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {TOKEN}", "Accept": "application/vnd.github.v3+json"} if TOKEN else {}

def copy_repository(source_full_repo, target_repo_name):
    print(f"🚀 Starting copy from {source_full_repo} to {target_repo_name}...")
    
    # Get user info for target owner
    user_res = requests.get("https://api.github.com/user", headers=HEADERS)
    if user_res.status_code != 200:
        print(f"❌ Failed to get user info: {user_res.text}")
        return
    owner = user_res.json().get("login")
    
    target_full = f"{owner}/{target_repo_name}"
    
    # 1. Check and Delete target repo if it exists
    del_res = requests.delete(f"https://api.github.com/repos/{target_full}", headers=HEADERS)
    if del_res.status_code == 204:
        print(f"🗑️ Existing repository {target_full} deleted successfully.")
    else:
        print(f"ℹ️ Target repository did not exist or was already clean.")
        
    # 2. Create new target repo
    create_payload = {"name": target_repo_name, "private": False}
    create_res = requests.post("https://api.github.com/user/repos", headers=HEADERS, json=create_payload)
    if create_res.status_code not in [200, 201]:
        print(f"❌ Failed to create repo: {create_res.text}")
        return
    print(f"✅ Created new repository: {target_full}")
    
    # 3. Get source repo tree (recursive)
    tree_res = requests.get(f"https://api.github.com/repos/{source_full_repo}/git/trees/main?recursive=1", headers=HEADERS)
    if tree_res.status_code != 200:
        # try master branch if main fails
        tree_res = requests.get(f"https://api.github.com/repos/{source_full_repo}/git/trees/master?recursive=1", headers=HEADERS)
    
    if tree_res.status_code != 200:
        print(f"❌ Failed to fetch source tree: {tree_res.text}")
        return
        
    tree_data = tree_res.json().get("tree", [])
    print(f"📦 Found {len(tree_data)} items in source repository.")
    
    # 4. Copy each blob (file)
    for item in tree_data:
        if item["type"] == "blob":
            path = item["path"]
            # Fetch blob content
            blob_res = requests.get(item["url"], headers=HEADERS)
            if blob_res.status_code == 200:
                blob_json = blob_res.json()
                content = blob_json.get("content", "")
                encoding = blob_json.get("encoding", "base64")
                
                # Push file to target repo
                put_url = f"https://api.github.com/repos/{target_full}/contents/{path}"
                put_payload = {
                    "message": f"Copy {path} from {source_full_repo}",
                    "content": content
                }
                put_res = requests.put(put_url, headers=HEADERS, json=put_payload)
                if put_res.status_code in [200, 201]:
                    print(f"📄 Copied: {path}")
                else:
                    print(f"⚠️ Failed to copy {path}: {put_res.status_code}")

    print("🎉 Repository copy completed successfully!")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    copy_repository("advik08k/sasta-coder", "sasta-coder-clone")
